headline: Names a Staten Island, New York post office building after Leonard Montalto.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3031 Veterans Road West in Staten Island, New York, as the "Leonard Montalto Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
